readme: Nutrition labels READ OFF THE PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPH in Brad's own Chrome, 2026-08-26, rung 4 of design\PLAN-food-db-provenance-2026-08-26.md. The label is a photograph in the Walmart image carousel - it is not in the page text, not in __NEXT_DATA__ (which carries only a collapsed NutritionValuePlaceholder), and no filename or alt-text regex finds it. An automated fetch of the same URL returns a bot wall; Brad's Chrome returns the product. Every panel here was transcribed from the image, household measure AND grams. status: LABEL = the product matches the row's own brand; PROXY = a different brand, recorded as standing in; CONFLICT = the panel disagrees with the stored row and NOTHING was written; UNFOUND = no panel could be reached, recorded rather than retried forever.

label.serving_g_note: panel states mL only; 240 g is the gram weight the stored row already uses for the same 1 cup measure

The front of pack prints 90 CALORIES PER SERVING and 4g NET CARBS, which corroborates the stored 90 cal - it is not a panel and is not recorded as one.
